grounding.states: Honda Odyssey is ranked #1 by U.S. News with an overall score of 9.3 out of 10
grounding.from: U.S. News ranks the 2026 Honda Odyssey #1. It gives the Odyssey an overall score of 9.3 out of 10.

grounding.states: Kelley Blue Book ranks the Honda Odyssey #1 in minivans
grounding.from: Kelley Blue Book (about 187 days old) ranks the 2026 Honda Odyssey #1 in minivans.

grounding.states: Car Talk's staff pick is the Odyssey
grounding.from: Car Talk is split. Its staff pick is the Odyssey.

grounding.states: Edmunds calls the Odyssey the minivan it most likes driving
grounding.from: Edmunds calls the Odyssey the minivan it most likes driving, and the best non-hybrid.

grounding.states: Toyota Sienna gets 36 mpg combined and is only sold as a hybrid
grounding.from: The Sienna gets 36 mpg combined in front-wheel drive. It's the only minivan offered only as a hybrid.

grounding.states: the major rankings do not agree on one best minivan
grounding.from: No single "best." The major rankings pick different winners.

value.answer: The Honda Odyssey, if you want the best all-round pick. U.S. News has it first with a 9.3 out of 10, Kelley Blue Book ranks it top too, and Car Talk's staff goes with it. Edmunds says it's the one they most like driving. If fuel economy matters most to you, get the Toyota Sienna instead: it's only sold as a hybrid and gets 36 mpg combined. The rankings don't agree on one winner, so it comes down to what you need most. This is for the U.S. market.
